subject.title: fix(gateway): force exit on zombie shutdown + 503 healthz during shutdown

question: Should OpenClaw Gateway adopt this PR's forced process exit after clean shutdown and strict internal `/healthz?strict=1` lock-recovery probe as the supported supervisor recovery contract?
rationale: The patch appears to address a real availability failure, but it intentionally changes process lifecycle behavior and adds an environment timeout surface, which repository policy treats as owner/compatibility-sensitive rather than an automation-only decision.

options.title: Accept the guarded shutdown contract
options.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms the default 5s forced-exit watchdog and strict internal probe are the intended Gateway supervisor behavior.

options.title: Require deployment proof first
options.body: Hold the PR until the branch is deployed in a real Gateway restart scenario and shows zombie recovery end to end.

options.title: Ask for a narrower default
options.body: Request a version that avoids forced process exit by default or makes the stricter recovery behavior supervisor-specific.

recommendation.title: Accept the guarded shutdown contract
recommendation.body: Merge after maintainer review confirms the default 5s forced-exit watchdog and strict internal probe are the intended Gateway supervisor behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the strongest recent merged history on Gateway close-maintenance and shutdown-path changes among the inspected related work.
